readings: Considering only tracks whose Bytes is strictly greater than 10,323,804, group them by MediaTypeId. For each media type, compute the average of Bytes divided by Milliseconds per track (ignoring missing values) and the number of tracks. Then return a single row with the unrounded average of those per-media-type average bytes-per-millisecond values and the unrounded average of those per-media-type track counts.

Considering only tracks whose Bytes is greater than or equal to 10,323,804, group them by MediaTypeId. For each media type, compute the average of Bytes divided by Milliseconds per track (ignoring missing values) and the number of tracks. Then return a single row with the unrounded average of those per-media-type average bytes-per-millisecond values and the unrounded average of those per-media-type track counts.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS avg_of_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(cnt) AS avg_track_count
FROM (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,
         AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
);
SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS avg_of_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(cnt) AS avg_track_count
FROM (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,

  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
);
